title: Feral Golf KYRO™ Performance Ferrule
body: Named for the ancient Greek kairos - the perfect, unrepeatable moment of contact. KYRO™ Performance Feral is engineered for exactly that. Precision-manufactured with an exterior pyramid texture and internally structured pyramid geometry, the KYRO™ ferrule absorbs unwanted vibration at impact, returns clean feedback to your hands, and moves through the air with less resistance than anything previously on your club. Small things make the game feel better. Grip tape. A freshly grooved wedge. The right glove on the right day. title: Zestful Zebra
body: Customise your irons with our unique Ferrules, weather its to match your headcovers or just to spice up your bag we have many colour variations to choose from. Each pack comes with a Clamp Golf Co, pouch and 10 Ferrules All our Ferrules come in .355 which will fit most irons, but, can also be fitted onto .370 shafts when placed in boiling soapy water for 5 minutes. We strongly advise that you get our Ferrules fitted by a Local professional or professional fitting centre to guarantee longevity of our Ferrules. Otherwise there are some great how to videos that you will find on YouTube that will explain every step of the way. We also offer a Ferrule fitting service at the Clamp Golf Co.
